overall_summary: Data shows clear audience affinity for husband-wife relationship dynamics ('रिश्ते'), which consistently outperform general sad shayaris and family member tropes by nearly 10x in views.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1672 views) and 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1766 views) significantly outperform all other topics.
winning_patterns.action: Allocate 70% of upcoming video slots to marriage and deep-rooted couple relationship complexities.

weak_patterns.pattern: Generic Sad Shayari / Heavy Urdu Poetry
weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 13 views due to overly abstract wording.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract poetic language; ground the content in everyday realistic visual situations.
